This is a test job - created by Alex Haugan, for testing candidate insights.
 
Join a scaling, tight-knit team that’s working directly with innovative talent acquisition teams and thought leaders across various industries and geographies to make hiring a strategic advantage for their organizations. You'll serve as an advisor to our customers and take a consultative approach to ensure customers are setup for long-term success as high performing hiring organizations using the Lever product suite.
 
As a Customer Success Manager on the Customer Advocacy team, you will be our customers biggest champion and make their voice heard in everything we do- the problems we help solve, the solutions we build and the consultation we deliver. You will do that by building trusting partnerships with our customers and consistently empowering them to achieve their ongoing talent goals with Lever. We advocate for our customers by working across Lever to deliver solutions and share our learnings internally to help shape our products.
 
We are looking for someone who is experienced in building lasting customer relationships and is passionate about making meaningful contributions to our customer’s success. Don’t be mistaken, this is a challenging career path but also highly rewarding. Are you up for the challenge? If so, stop reading and start applying.

descricao_texto: We believe Sales Engineers at Lever are involved in all stages of the customer’s development lifecycle and are experienced using presentations, email, phone and social media to connect with customers. We are looking for great teammates that can build sales presentations, product demonstrations, and educate customers (everyone from developers to product managers to C-level executives) on the best ways to ATS technology. We believe in Lever’s Sales Engineers empathize with customers and quickly discern their true technical needs by asking detailed and clarifying questions and presenting solutions that target those needs. You have the rare combination of technical savviness and business insight and you’re looking for a career where you can utilize both. As a Sales Engineer at Lever, you will hone each of these skills by advising a diverse set of customers on what is possible using Lever's Platform.

Lever is looking for an experienced Solutions Engineer to join our growing go-to-market team. In this role, you’ll work directly with sales, product, and customer success to help establish a clear fit for the Sisu platform within our customers’ analytics and business intelligence workflows. In addition to helping bring new customers to the platform, you’ll lead the technical pre-sales relationship, develop new technical architectures, and offer creative solutions to unique problems.

You’ll also act as a critical liaison between Sales and Product, sharing critical feedback with the Product and Marketing teams, to inform the roadmap and go-to-market strategy for our operational analytics platform. In your daily interactions with customers, you’ll have the chance to combine your practical knowledge of analytics and data science workflows with a desire to tinker, whiteboard, brainstorm, and figure out better ways to solve tough problems.

On our small, dynamic team, you’ll have opportunities beyond customer engagements as well. Our Solutions Engineers help mentor new team members, present at events large and small, and help author content read by a global audience.

Lever is looking to add another rock star Senior Software Developer, Platform to our growing, best-in-class, development team. 

Who we are 
Better Work and a Better World: at Lever that’s what we’re all about. We’re a software company in the business of doing good, building better ways for companies to connect with their customers and employees around causes (we make “doing well by doing good” more than just a tagline!). We’re growing fast and looking for more great people to join us. 

We’re not Bono, just a passionate crew of workhorses out to change the world. We have that fun, flexible tech culture that people love (ok, some people – you know who you are!) – and we have a heart. We’re a registered B Corporation, which means we’re part of a new breed of companies committed to higher social and environmental standards. 
You’ll join a dedicated, passionate team that creates innovative solutions (we have been honoured with two TechRev Innovators Awards) for our raving fans (er, clients). And you’ll get to rub shoulders with some of the most iconic and notable companies and charities in the world to help them make a difference (in even better ways). Our entrepreneurial environment appeals to self-driven, flexible team players who learn quickly, aren’t afraid to tackle hard problems and don’t mind wearing jeans to work. Sound cool? Join us!
